selection: Next 25 unresolved colleges by 2026 General Round-1 demand from the 100-profile build.
methodology: Current lived/student evidence, formal disciplinary cases, official safeguards and evidence gaps are separately labelled.
PG/resident, nursing/allied-health and unrelated campus-security incidents do not populate MBBS fresher culture.
No phase timing is added unless a source actually supports the timing.
